title: pyrus × mitschurinii
intro: Pyrus × mitschurinii, commonly known as the Pyrus mitschurinii or more specifically, the 'Mitschurin's pear' or 'Chinese pear' cultivar, is a hybrid plant derived from the cross between Pyrus communis and Pyrus ussuriensis. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Pyrus × mitschurinii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as wound healing, anti-cancer, and anti-diabetic properties. The therapeutic actions of Pyrus × mitschurinii also include antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities, which have been attributed to its flavonoid and phenolic acid content.
